data.headline: Sr. Staff Systems Design Engineer @ Dexcom | System Integration, Testing
data.about:
Accomplished and results driven leader for high volume, sophisticated wireless consumer products. In-depth understanding of hardware and software development processes in a fast-paced environment. Strong project manager with a solid history of hands-on experience, possessing a unique combination of people, business and technical skills. Successfully managed multi-site international teams and project activities in all phases of the development cycle. Implemented test solutions and managed test teams located in US, Finland, Mexico and Asia. Experienced in working with 3rd party suppliers for test and certification to satisfy internal and external customer as well as regulatory requirements. 

Skills Summary: 
Project / Program Management | Hardware & Software Development | Quality Assurance | Agile / Scrum Methodology | Python / C / C++ Programming | Regulatory Requirements | Software & Hardware Testing | Cross-Functional Team Builder | Product Certification | Customer / Carrier requirements | MS Project and Scheduling Tools | Virtual Teams Management | Wireless Standards | Budgeting and Budget Control | Risk Management | Change Management | CAPA | Lean Six Sigma | ISO 9001 | Regulatory Affairs | ISO 13485 | ISO 14971 | 21 CFR 820 | GxPs | 21 CFR 210, 211
data.addressWithCountry: San Diego Metropolitan Area United States

description.text:
• Systems Engineering & Requirements Management: Led end-to-end system, hardware, and firmware requirements engineering for medical device / CGM wearable systems, authoring and managing traceable requirements in Jama Connect in alignment with INCOSE, iCGM Special Controls, and regulatory design control standards.

• Design Controls, Verification & Risk: Developed and maintained system and subsystem-level design inputs, identified and remediated requirements gaps, supported FMEA risk assessments, and participated in design reviews to ensure performance, reliability, verification, and regulatory compliance across the product lifecycle.

• Cross-Functional Leadership & Communication: Drove cross-functional collaboration with hardware, firmware, test, manufacturing, and quality teams, translating complex technical concepts to engineering and non-technical stakeholders to enable system integration and scalable manufacturing readiness.•

• Manufacturing Test Systems Ownership: Served as System Owner for PCBA and Final Functional Test Systems supporting high-volume medical device manufacturing, owning test station software and hardware across the full lifecycle from concept through mass production and contract manufacturing deployment.

• Validation, Verification & Compliance: Led development and execution of Design Validation and V&V activities, including test plans, protocols, test cases, risk assessments, traceability matrices, and SAT / IQ / OQ / PQ, ensuring compliance with regulated manufacturing and quality system requirements.

• Secure Systems & Cross-Functional Integration: Implemented cryptography and PKI within manufacturing systems and partnered cross-functionally with R&D firmware and hardware teams to develop communication protocols, functional test methods, and calibration strategies for scalable production.

• 5G-NR characterization and implementation of testing plans and requirements for pre-silicon systems
• Developed functional test systems from PCBA to System level test for 5G-NR test platforms.

First Article Inspection (FAI) project support that provided corrective actions to our manufacturing process.

•	Factory Re-Qualification test plans and results analysis to monitor supplier component quality.
